text: For seed 24 at d_model=128, the N=64 minus N=128 layer-1 force gap is flat at about 0.054-0.064 on data_seed 0, but on data_seed 1 it widens from about 0.042 (steps 500-1500) to about 0.071 (steps 4000-6000). Does the data_seed 1 gap keep widening through 12000 steps or settle near 0.07? Is the difference between datasets mainly that N=64 force on data_seed 1 keeps rising later in training?
